statement: Let T be the finite ordinary tree consisting of path0-1-2 with m distinct branch centers joined to0, the i-th center having r_i private degree-one tips. Let x be the first strict coefficient descent of I(T), including the terminal zero-extended difference, and alpha=alpha(T). For every natural p with x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1, fix F to be precisely the original leaves v with Delta_p(T-v)<0, using original supports s_v, and let S=sum over v in F of [Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v])]. For every profile with m>=1 and all r_i in {2,3,4}, S<=0.
scope: Exact heterogeneous path-plus-private-star family with m>=1 and all r_i in {2,3,4}; every eligible rank and every original distinct leaf tag, strict selector. Neither arbitrary trees nor a governed RTree bridge. All-m and restricted-cutoff identities are separate scopes.
